### Package Installation

```{r include=FALSE}
install.packages("tidyverse") # Tidyverse packages contain tools for data manipulation, cleaning, string parsing and visualization
library(tidyverse) 
```

### Reading all csv files

```{r}
library(data.table) # for reading csvs  
species <- fread("data/899_Species.csv") 
synonyms <- read_csv("data/synonyms.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
traits <- read_csv("data/traits.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
observation <- fread("data/observation.csv")
survey_header <- read_csv("data/header.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
location <- read_csv("data/location.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

### Perform any data manipulation here:

#### Observation

##### 1. Rename columns

```{r}
library(data.table) 
## Rename columns 
observation <- fread("data/observation.csv")
setnames(observation, old = c("sd_ID", "sd_SpeciesORIG","sd_quality", "sd_Breeding"), new = c("survey_id","species_id", "survey_quality", "breeding_status"))   
colnames(observation) 
```

##### 2. Cleaning

```{r}
# removing rejected records from observation table
unique(observation$survey_quality)  
```

#### Species

##### 1. Rename species table 

```{r}
species <- fread("data/899_Species.csv")  
setnames(species, old = c("spNo", "sName", "sciName","IOC_Species_ID", "species_Notes", "observation_Count"), new = c("species_id", "species_name", "species_sciname", "ioc_species_id", "species_notes", "observation_count"))  
colnames(species) 
```

### Data Viz 

##### Pie chart of Birds observed 

```{r}
library(ggplot2) 

species_summary <- species[order(-observation_count)]

# --- Option A: Pie chart, top N + "Other" ---
top_n <- 5
species_summary[, group := ifelse(.I <= top_n, species_name, "Other")]

plot_data <- species_summary[, .(total_count = sum(observation_count)), by = group]

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = "", y = total_count, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(width = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  labs(title = "Observations by Species", fill = "Species") +
  theme_void()
```
